items.title: How Big Could CVS Health Stock's Next Fall Be?
items.summary: CVS Health stock closed at $79.65 on Monday. That is 27% below its highest close of the past year. It lost 10.1% in the week to Monday, counting dividends, while the S&P 500 lost 2.4%. If the market turns from here, how much further could it fall, and how long could you wait to get back.
